items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: that's the first time I was recording with little groups, with Dizzy, myself, Charlie Parker, Don Byas.

ctx.x: But New York was a fun spot. This was a fun place. You wouldn't want to be anywhere else then because everything happened there. And all the bands that were on the road, they were just aching to get back to New York, not to make money, but where all the action was, you know? And it was really there.

And there was an awful lot of recording going on then and even later on, where little groups would get together and record. You know, that's the first time I was recording with little groups, with Dizzy, myself, Charlie Parker, Don Byas. Some guy would just call us to come make a record, and we'd go make these record dates at that time.

Somebody said there was a building where an awful lot of recording took place. You'd make a record in one small studio, and you'd walk out in the hall and somebody would grab you and take you into another studio, and you'd be recording with somebody else. I can't remember (inaudible).
